speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Here, Alse. Three of them, out of Smithfield, and the middle one has gilt on him.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Oh, sir, all three of them whole. Look at the gold on him, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fairings rot the teeth. Put them on the dresser, girl, and do not eat the gilt before your supper.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I'll keep the gilt one on the shelf, Mistress, and only look at him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have been on those stones, Master Shakespeare. I can tell by the way you hold the stair-post.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The back began to complain from the fourth hour. Tomorrow we open at two, and tonight nobody in the company will con a line.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go up, and let the back lie flat before you have to bow in the new paint.
